text_en: Oh, rebellious children, says the Lord , who carry out a plan, but not mine; who make an alliance, but against my will, adding sin to sin;
text_cn: 祸哉，悖逆的子民──上主的断语！他们自作主张，不请示于我；自订盟约，不依照我的精神，致使罪上加罪。

text_en: who set out to go down to Egypt without asking for my counsel, to take refuge in the protection of Pharaoh, and to seek shelter in the shadow of Egypt;
text_cn: 他们没有请求我的许可，便起程南下埃及，想托庇于法郎的保障之下，想隐匿于埃及的荫庇之下。

text_en: Therefore the protection of Pharaoh shall become your shame, and the shelter in the shadow of Egypt your humiliation.
text_cn: 但是法郎的保障将是你们的羞耻，隐匿于埃及的荫庇之下，将是一种污辱。

text_en: For though his officials are at Zoan and his envoys reach Hanes,
text_cn: 虽然他的首领已在左罕，他的使者已到达哈乃斯；

text_en: everyone comes to shame through a people that cannot profit them, that brings neither help nor profit, but shame and disgrace.
text_cn: 但是他们都要因这于他们毫无裨益的民族而受到羞惭，因为这民族为他们不但毫无帮助，毫无益处，反而是一种羞耻和污辱。

text_en: An oracle concerning the animals of the Negeb. Through a land of trouble and distress, of lioness and roaring lion, of viper and flying serpent, they carry their riches on the backs of donkeys, and their treasures on the humps of camels, to a people that cannot profit them.
text_cn: 他们以牲畜带着贵物经过南方──残酷苦痛的地域，即壮狮和牝（pìn）狮咆哮，蝮蛇和火蛇飞行的地域──驴背上驮着他们的财富，骆驼背上驮着他们的宝物，到一个于他们毫无裨益的民族那里去。

text_en: For Egypt’s help is worthless and empty, therefore I have called her, “Rahab who sits still. ”
text_cn: 埃及人的援助是无用的，是空虚的，因此我称呼她是“静坐的辣哈布”。

text_en: Go now, write it before them on a tablet, and inscribe it in a book, so that it may be for the time to come as a witness forever.
text_cn: 你现在去，当他们面前，写在版上，记在书中，为后世作证据：

text_en: For they are a rebellious people, faithless children, children who will not hear the instruction of the Lord ;
text_cn: “这是一个反叛的民族，不忠实的子女，拒绝听从上主法律的子民。”

text_en: who say to the seers, “Do not see”; and to the prophets, “Do not prophesy to us what is right; speak to us smooth things, prophesy illusions,
text_cn: 他们曾对先见者说：“你们不要再看异象。”对先知说：“你们不要给我们说什么预言，给我们说些好听的话，预示些幻想故事吧！

text_en: leave the way, turn aside from the path, let us hear no more about the Holy One of Israel. ”
text_cn: 离开你们的正道吧！转移你们的路线吧！在我们面前不要再提以色列的圣者！”

text_en: Therefore thus says the Holy One of Israel: Because you reject this word, and put your trust in oppression and deceit, and rely on them;
text_cn: 因此，以色列的圣者这样说：“因为你们藐视了这话，而依赖邪说谬论，且倾心信赖；

text_en: therefore this iniquity shall become for you like a break in a high wall, bulging out, and about to collapse, whose crash comes suddenly, in an instant;
text_cn: 所以这罪恶，为你们将如一堵高墙上突起而将倒下的缺口，顷刻之间就会突然坍塌，

text_en: its breaking is like that of a potter’s vessel that is smashed so ruthlessly that among its fragments not a sherd is found for taking fire from the hearth, or dipping water out of the cistern.
text_cn: 坍塌得有如毫不痛惜地被摔碎的陶器，碎得找不到一块碎片，能用以从炉中取火，从井里取水。”

text_en: For thus said the Lord God , the Holy One of Israel: In returning and rest you shall be saved; in quietness and in trust shall be your strength. But you refused
text_cn: 因为吾主上主，以色列的圣者这样说过：“你们的得救是在于归依和安静，你们的力量是在于宁静和信赖。”然而你们不愿意；

text_en: and said, “No! We will flee upon horses”— therefore you shall flee! and, “We will ride upon swift steeds”— therefore your pursuers shall be swift!
text_cn: 你们反说：“不！我们要骑马逃去！”的确，你们必要逃去。“我们要乘骏马疾驰。”的确，追击你们的必然疾驰。

text_en: A thousand shall flee at the threat of one, at the threat of five you shall flee, until you are left like a flagstaff on the top of a mountain, like a signal on a hill.
text_cn: 千人要逃避一人的叱（chì）咤（zhà），万人要逃避五人的叱咤，直到你们所剩余的，有如山顶上的木杆，或山岭上的旗帜。

text_en: Therefore the Lord waits to be gracious to you; therefore he will rise up to show mercy to you. For the Lord is a God of justice; blessed are all those who wait for him.
text_cn: 然而上主仍旧等着向你们施惠，仍高兴向你们表示怜爱，因为上主是正义的天主，凡仰赖他的人是有福的。

text_en: Truly, O people in Zion, inhabitants of Jerusalem, you shall weep no more. He will surely be gracious to you at the sound of your cry; when he hears it, he will answer you.
text_cn: 熙雍的百姓，耶路撒冷的居民啊！你不会再恸（tòng）哭，他必垂怜你呼求的声音，他一听见必要应允你。

text_en: Though the Lord may give you the bread of adversity and the water of affliction, yet your Teacher will not hide himself any more, but your eyes shall see your Teacher.
text_cn: 吾主纵然给你们困苦的食物和酸辛的水，但你的教师再不躲藏，你的眼睛必能常见到你的教师

text_en: And when you turn to the right or when you turn to the left, your ears shall hear a word behind you, saying, “This is the way; walk in it. ”
text_cn: 当你偏左或偏右时，你必会亲耳听到你后面有声音说：“这是正路，你们要在这上面行！”

text_en: Then you will defile your silver-covered idols and your gold-plated images. You will scatter them like filthy rags; you will say to them, “Away with you! ”
text_cn: 你必以那包银的木偶和包金的神像为不洁之物，将它们抛弃，有如抛弃月经布一样，并对它说：“去吧！”

text_en: He will give rain for the seed with which you sow the ground, and grain, the produce of the ground, which will be rich and plenteous. On that day your cattle will graze in broad pastures;
text_cn: 你把种子种在地里，上主必使雨降在其上，并使你地里出产的食粮丰盛富饶；那一日你的群畜必将在广阔的草场上牧放。

text_en: and the oxen and donkeys that till the ground will eat silage, which has been winnowed with shovel and fork.
text_cn: 耕田的牛和驴驹必吃用木杴或簸箕扬净而拌上盐的刍（chú）料。

text_en: On every lofty mountain and every high hill there will be brooks running with water—on a day of the great slaughter, when the towers fall.
text_cn: 大行惨杀之日，当堡楼倒塌之时， 所有的高山峻岭必有溪水涓涓细流。

text_en: Moreover the light of the moon will be like the light of the sun, and the light of the sun will be sevenfold, like the light of seven days, on the day when the Lord binds up the injuries of his people, and heals the wounds inflicted by his blow.
text_cn: 当上主包扎他百姓的创口，治疗他们伤痕的那日，月亮的光华将似太阳的光华，而太阳的光华必增加七倍，有如积累了七天的光华。

text_en: See, the name of the Lord comes from far away, burning with his anger, and in thick rising smoke; his lips are full of indignation, and his tongue is like a devouring fire;
text_cn: 看哪！上主的名由远方而来，他怒火如焚，浓烟冲天；他的口唇满了敌忾（kài），他的舌头有如吞噬的火焰；

text_en: his breath is like an overflowing stream that reaches up to the neck— to sift the nations with the sieve of destruction, and to place on the jaws of the peoples a bridle that leads them astray.
text_cn: 他的气息如泛滥的河川，涨到人的颈项；他要用荡灭的筛子筛净列国，用引入歧途的马勒拑住万民的下颚。

text_en: You shall have a song as in the night when a holy festival is kept; and gladness of heart, as when one sets out to the sound of the flute to go to the mountain of the Lord , to the Rock of Israel.
text_cn: 你们必要讴歌，有如欢祝庆节之夜；内心愉快，有如在笛声之下登上主的山，到以色列的磐石那里去一样。

text_en: And the Lord will cause his majestic voice to be heard and the descending blow of his arm to be seen, in furious anger and a flame of devouring fire, with a cloudburst and tempest and hailstones.
text_cn: 上主必使人听见他尊严的声音，见到他降临的手臂，在狂怒之中，在吞噬的火焰中，在狂风、暴雨、冰雹之中。

text_en: The Assyrian will be terror-stricken at the voice of the Lord , when he strikes with his rod.
text_cn: 亚述必因上主的声音而战栗，上主必用刑杖击打亚述。

text_en: And every stroke of the staff of punishment that the Lord lays upon him will be to the sound of timbrels and lyres; battling with brandished arm he will fight with him.
text_cn: 当上主惩戒的刑杖加于他们身上时，每次击挞都是在敲鼓和弹琴的声中执行的。他将以激烈的战争击败他们。

text_en: For his burning place has long been prepared; truly it is made ready for the king, its pyre made deep and wide, with fire and wood in abundance; the breath of the Lord , like a stream of sulfur, kindles it.
text_cn: 因为托斐特已准备好多时，还是为君王而设的，又深又广，堆满了许多柴火；上主的气息有如一条硫磺河流，把它点燃起来。
